source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
old: A-mol je hvat E pomaknut na tanje žice: prsti 2 i 3 na pragu 2, prst 1 na žici 2, pragu 1.
new: A-mol je hvat E pomaknut za jednu žicu prema tanjima: prsti 2 i 3 na pragu 2, prst 1 na žici 2, pragu 1.
reason: The original says exactly one string thinner. The draft says only onto thinner strings, losing the size of the physical movement. Restores one-string displacement without changing digits or pitch symbols.

source: Does this end at home?
old: Završava li ovo na osnovnom tonu?
new: Završava li ovo na tonici?
reason: The same prompt is used for both single-note melodies and chord cadences, confirmed in the curriculum sound arrays (for example gtr-3-spotlight and gtr-6-spotlight). Osnovni ton narrows home to a chord root/single note; tonika describes the tonal home for both melody and harmony.

source: D minor: one note lower
old: D-mol: jedan ton niže
new: D-mol: jedan ton ide niže
reason: The lesson lowers just one chord tone from F sharp to F, not the whole chord by one whole tone. Jedan ton niže can mean a whole tone lower in Croatian; jedan ton ide niže keeps one note as the subject being lowered, matching the next card.

source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
old: Septakord dodaje ton koji vuče prema osnovnom tonu. D7 želi prijeći u G. Prsti: 2 na žici 3, pragu 2; 1 na žici 2, pragu 1; 3 na žici 1, pragu 2.
new: Septakord dodaje ton koji vuče prema tonici. D7 želi prijeći u G. Prsti: 2 na žici 3, pragu 2; 1 na žici 2, pragu 1; 3 na žici 1, pragu 2.
reason: Home here is the tonic harmony G, not necessarily its single root pitch. The draft narrows the harmonic tendency to osnovni ton; tonika preserves the intended resolution without implying the added seventh itself must move to the root.

source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
old: Kvintni akord sadrži samo osnovni ton i kvintu, ton pet slovnih mjesta više. Nije ni dur ni mol i ostaje prodoran, čak i glasno odsviran. E5 je donji dio E-mola.
new: Kvintni akord sadrži samo osnovni ton i kvintu, peti ton kad slova brojiš od osnovnog tona. Nije ni dur ni mol i ostaje prodoran, čak i glasno odsviran. E5 je donji dio E-mola.
reason: Pet slovnih mjesta više suggests moving five places, which gives a sixth. A fifth counts the root as the first letter. Explicit inclusive counting preserves the intended root/fifth lesson; authoritative Croatian definition is the first-to-fifth scale-degree interval (https://www.enciklopedija.hr/clanak/kvinta).

source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
old: Rock često gradi napetost prigušenim osminkama, a zatim stiže na otvoreni akord. Podigni dlan za snažan potez i pusti ga da zvoni.
new: Rock često gradi napetost prigušenim osminkama, a zatim stiže na neprigušeni akord. Podigni dlan za snažan potez i pusti ga da zvoni.
reason: Open contrasts with palm-muted sound in this exercise, not with a movable/barre chord position. Neprigušeni makes the intended release of muting explicit; the following instruction confirms lifting the palm.

source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
old: Koji je otvoreni hvat pomaknut prag više bare hvat F?
new: Koji otvoreni hvat pomakneš prag više da dobiješ bare hvat F?
reason: The draft question has incompatible predicates and no grammatical relation between the shifted shape and F. This natural interrogative preserves the same open-shape identification and one-fret shift.

source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
old: Travisov stil, nazvan po Merleu Travisu, drži palac u izmjeni na svaku dobu, dok prsti trzaju između, na i.
new: U Travisovu stilu, nazvanom po Merleu Travisu, palac izmjenjuje basovske tonove na svaku dobu, dok prsti trzaju između, na i.
reason: Drži palac u izmjeni is unnatural Croatian and obscures the action. The revised sentence explicitly says the thumb alternates bass notes on every beat while the fingers fill the ands, preserving the named technique and timing.

source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
old: Obrazac se okreće na vrhu: p, i, m, a, pa m i i na povratku.
new: Obrazac se okreće na vrhu: p, i, m, a, pa m te i na povratku.
reason: The repeated i in m i i makes the conjunction and fingering symbol visually ambiguous. Croatian te expresses and without changing either symbol or the sequence.

source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
old: Ništa novo: izmjenični bas, p-i-m-a, Travisov stil i balada. Drži palac ravnomjernim i pusti svaki ton da zvoni.
new: Ništa novo: izmjenični bas, p-i-m-a, Travisov stil i balada. Neka palac svira ravnomjerno i pusti svaki ton da zvoni.
reason: Drži palac ravnomjernim unnaturally attributes rhythmic evenness to the body part rather than its playing. The new instruction says to play evenly with the thumb while preserving sustained sound.

source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
old: B7 je pet slovnih mjesta iznad E. Pet mjesta iznad A je E, pa E7 preuzima njegovu ulogu.
new: Osnovni ton akorda B7 peti je po redu kad slova brojiš od E. Kad brojiš od A, peti je E, pa E7 preuzima njegovu ulogu.
reason: The fifth must use inclusive counting; pet mjesta iznad suggests five offsets. Names the fifth letter counted from the root without changing pitch/chord notation (see terminology-evidence.md).

source: Visit the four chord early
old: Posjeti četvrti akord ranije
new: Ranije posjeti akord četvrtog stupnja
reason: The four chord means harmony on the fourth scale degree, not the fourth chord in a sequence. Names the degree explicitly within the title-length limit.

source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
old: Pri ranoj promjeni takt 2 skače na četvrti akord i odmah natrag. U A: A7, D7, A7, A7. To dodaje pokret od samog početka.
new: Pri ranoj promjeni takt 2 skače na akord četvrtog stupnja i odmah natrag. U A: A7, D7, A7, A7. To dodaje pokret od samog početka.
reason: Clarifies that four chord is the fourth-degree harmony; četvrti akord could incorrectly mean the fourth chord in order.

source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
old: Četvrti akord u A je D7. Rana promjena posjećuje ga u taktu 2, pa se vraća na A7.
new: Akord četvrtog stupnja u A je D7. Rana promjena posjećuje ga u taktu 2, pa se vraća na A7.
reason: Uses the same explicit fourth-scale-degree term as the quick-change title/card; preserves the chord sequence and bar number.

source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
old: Drži ruku u šesnaestinkama, ali opusti prste na vratu da većina poteza daje suhe, šuškave klikove. Pritisni samo za jasne udare.
new: Nastavi pomicati ruku u ritmu šesnaestinki, ali opusti prste na vratu da većina poteza daje suhe, šuškave klikove. Pritisni samo za jasne udare.
reason: Drži ruku u šesnaestinkama is unnatural and omits the explicit continuous-motion instruction. Names moving the hand in sixteenth-note rhythm while retaining the contrast between relaxed muted strokes and pressed hits.

source: Reggae: the offbeat chop
old: Reggae: kratki udar između doba
new: Reggae: kratki udari na slabim dobama
reason: The full lesson explicitly places the chop on beats two and four (card and quiz), not between the beats. Here English offbeat denotes weak beats. Između doba contradicts the lesson; na slabim dobama matches its actual rhythmic placement without changing source text.

source: The chorus, picked at fret 5
old: Refren, prstima na pragu 5
new: Refren, trzanjem na pragu 5
reason: Picked does not specify fingers rather than a plectrum in this CAGED exercise. Prstima unnecessarily narrows the technique; trzanjem preserves the picked articulation while allowing the source’s choice of implement.

source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
old: D na pragovima 7, 7 i 5 ima osnovni hvat kao tvoj C na pragu 5. Niže, pragovi 2, 3 i 2 čine vrh otvorenog D.
new: D na pragovima 7, 7 i 5 ima hvat osnovnog oblika kao tvoj C na pragu 5. Niže, pragovi 2, 3 i 2 čine vrh otvorenog D.
reason: Root position is the chord’s osnovni oblik, distinguished from inversions in this lesson. Osnovni hvat merely suggests a basic fingering and loses the inversion contrast.

source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
old: Petlja pjesme Koturaljkalište ide jedan, šest, četiri, pet u G. Koji je akord šest?
new: Petlja pjesme Koturaljkalište slijedi prvi, šesti, četvrti i peti stupanj G-dura. Koji je akord na šestom stupnju?
reason: The one/six/four/five labels are harmonic scale degrees, not arbitrary chord numbers. Explicit degree wording removes the awkward akord šest and matches the immediately following G-major counting explanation.

source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
old: Broji uz G-dur: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akord na 6 je molski: E-mol.
new: Broji uz G-dur: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akord na 6. stupnju je molski: E-mol.
reason: Names the sixth degree explicitly to align with the corrected degree-identification question; all source digits and note letters stay unchanged.

source: Which one is the open G string?

new: U kojem primjeru čuješ praznu žicu G?
reason: Koji je primjer prazna žica G equates the example with a physical string and reads unnaturally. Ask which example contains the sound of the open G string, preserving the first/second choices.

reason: Uses the same natural sound-example formulation as the open-G comparison, without changing the target pitch or open-string distinction.

source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
old: Jazz svirači često puštaju akord da zvoni samo trenutak. Stisni pri potezu i odmah popusti pa će akordi početi njihati.
new: Jazz svirači često puštaju akord da zvoni samo trenutak. Stisni pri potezu i odmah popusti pa će se akordi početi njihati.
reason: The Croatian intransitive sense of swing/sway requires njihati se; the old phrase lacks se and reads as an incomplete transitive construction. The squeeze/release and short-chord instructions remain unchanged.

source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
old: Kasna odjava izvorna je pjesma Timbre: lo-fi u C uz Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 i Am7. To je ii–V–I, uz šesti akord za novi krug. Prati je bare septakordima i Charleston ritmom. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.
new: Kasna odjava izvorna je pjesma Timbre: lo-fi u C uz Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 i Am7. To je ii–V–I, uz akord na šestom stupnju za novi krug. Prati je bare septakordima i Charleston ritmom. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.
reason: The six chord is vi (Am7) in C, not the sixth chord in the four-chord sequence. Explicit scale-degree wording preserves harmonic function and matches the listed chords.

source: Rest the body against your chest with the neck pointing left. The string nearest the floor is string 1. It plays the highest open note.
old: Nasloni tijelo instrumenta na prsa, s vratom usmjerenim ulijevo. Žica najbliža podu je žica 1. Ona daje najviši prazni ton.

source: Which finger plays the C chord?

new: Koji prst svira akord C?

source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
old: Kod melodije u akordima ruka na vratu drži akord, a ti iz njega trzaš melodiju. Drži F i C, F i A već su ti pod prstima.

source: A ballad to pick

new: Balada s trzanim akordima

source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
